test_multi_node_sagemaker_training: test multi-node data parallel training on AWS SageMaker using HuggingFace estimator with run_glue.py script
create_sagemaker_estimator: create a HuggingFace SageMaker estimator for distributed data parallel training with configurable instance count and distribution settings
run_ddp_training_job: run a distributed data parallel training job on SageMaker using run_ddp.py or run_glue.py with smdistributed dataparallel
export_training_metrics: export SageMaker training job metrics to CSV using TrainingJobAnalytics for post-training evaluation
validate_training_kpis: validate training KPIs including train runtime, eval accuracy, and eval loss against expected thresholds
